title: The upgrade steps test the old cs-sandbox pin
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)

evidence.verified: In a scratch clone at 8fd7503, `make tools` built bin/tools/cs-sandbox at the sandbox version go.mod pins. So a pin moved first is the cs-sandbox `make test-integration` runs. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: CONTRIBUTING.md now has the pin moved in the working tree first. `make test-integration` then runs the new cs-sandbox, which `make tools` builds at that pin, and the pin is committed only once it passes.
details: CONTRIBUTING.md says to install the new cs-sandbox, run `make test-integration`, and only then move the pin. `make test-integration` runs bin/tools, which `make tools` builds at the pin go.mod names. So the validation step runs the old cs-sandbox, and the new one is never tested before its pin is committed.
